name: manual_80f7b1
claim: A provisional correction removes a lesson from structured recall. recall.py takes only the latest row per lesson id and skips every row that is not accepted, and correct_lesson.py can only append provisional or retracted rows. After correcting a lesson that must stay recallable, end the chain with an accepted superseding lesson (learn.py --stage-only, then graduate.py --supersedes), and confirm with recall.py --quiet that it is returned. Run recall with --quiet when checking, because a plain run appends a proactive-recall row to the episodic log.

decisions.notes: lesson_9bcf2ac7d3ce was hidden from recall from its first provisional correction on 2026-11-23, and a later correction chain also dropped its spend-gate requirement from the rendered lesson layer. Found in the PR 524 review and confirmed by running recall before and after the accepted supersession lesson_957217e78f07.
